semantic_trajectory_derivation: 21 conditions x 300 items x 2 independent rollouts

qap.multiplicity: omnibus maxT across M0/M1/M2 then single-step maxT metric attribution

identifiability.family_leverage_formula: incident centered-z squared energy / (2 total squared energy)

radial_gate.family_signflip_16_point_p: diagnostic only; minimum 0.0625 cannot meet alpha 0.05

null_controllers.construction: fresh Gaussian bases SVD-projected against eight-direction meaningful span, mutually orthogonal, shell-amplitude matched
null_controllers.role: controls/diagnostics; excluded from primary meaningful relational population

classification_taxonomy.G1: M0 and/or M1 passes the full relational gate
classification_taxonomy.G2: M2 passes the full relational gate while M0/M1 do not
classification_taxonomy.G3: M2 passes and both superiority contrasts pass effect, bootstrap, and corrected QAP gates
classification_taxonomy.radial: R+ iff redesigned radial gate passes; otherwise R-; reported independently

decision_reason: At rho 0.40 and N=300, synthetic dependent M2 maxT/full-gate power averaged only about 0.30 across regimes; N=400 improved it only to about 0.31. Controller/family diversity, not item count, is the binding limit.
